evidence_quotes: Valmet will replace three existing quality control systems from other suppliers with Valmet IQ Quality Control Systems (QCS) at Hansol Paper’s Janghang, Shintanjin, and Cheonan mills in Korea.
The order was included in Valmet’s orders received for the first quarter of 2026
